نرباد (form XI)
# نَرْبَادُّ (narbāddu) /nar.baːd.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْبَادَّ (irbādda)
# نَرْبَادَّ (narbādda) /nar.baːd.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْبَادَّ (irbādda)
# نَرْبَادِّ (narbāddi) /nar.baːd.di/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْبَادَّ (irbādda)
